post.description:
Create target

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit", "campaign_edit", "dsp_campaign_edit"]

Delete target

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit", "campaign_edit", "dsp_campaign_edit"]

List target

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit", "dsp_campaign_view", "campaign_view", 
"advertiser_campaign_view", "campaign_edit", "dsp_campaign_edit"]

Update target

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Note:** For Amazon DSP, `state` supports only ENABLED and ARCHIVED; PAUSED is not a valid state for DSP targets.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit"]
